title: InferLoadedMap
description: Maps each key of a catalog DEFINITION record to its resolved runtime resource type. Keyed on CatalogEntry, not `AssetInput`: a materialized catalog may have been defined with bare path strings, which `AssetInput` (configs and `Asset` descriptors only) does not cover — the loader consumes the already materialized leaves and must not re-validate the definition entries.
